description: Browser extension to sync Google Calendar events with Jira tasks and worklogs.

userStories.title: Setup Page & Credential Storage
userStories.description: As a user, I need to configure my Jira credentials so the extension can access my Jira instance.
acceptanceCriteria: Create setup page UI
Input fields for Jira Domain, Email, and API Token
Securely store credentials in browser storage
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Project Fetching & Selection
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select which Jira projects to sync to limit the scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch available projects from Jira API using stored credentials
Display list of projects to user
Allow user to select multiple projects
Save selected project keys to config
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Initial Background Sync
userStories.description: As a user, I want tasks to be cached locally for fast searching.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch tasks from selected projects via Jira API
Cache tasks in local storage/browser storage
Implement background sync mechanism
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Calendar UI Injection
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the extension interface within the Google Calendar event modal.
acceptanceCriteria: Inject extension UI container into Google Calendar event creation/edit modal
Ensure UI appears correctly in the DOM
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Task Linking (Fuzzy Search)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to easily find and link Jira tasks to my calendar events.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement search input in injected UI
Search against local cache first
Fallback to Jira API search if not found in cache
Select task and link to event (store metadata in description or title)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Task Creation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create new Jira tasks directly from the calendar if they don't exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide UI to create new task if search fails
Allow selecting project and optional parent task
Create task in Jira via API
Automatically link new task to the current event
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Worklog Sync
userStories.description: As a user, I want my calendar time to be automatically logged to Jira.
acceptanceCriteria: Create worklog in Jira when event is created/linked
Update worklog duration/time when event is resized or moved
Delete worklog from Jira when event is deleted
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Estimated Time Prompt
userStories.description: As a user, I want to set an estimated time when I first link a task.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt user for estimated time when linking a task for the first time
Use this estimate for the initial worklog or task field
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

notes.title: Setup Page Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.description: Improve the setup page UX by renaming Projects to Spaces, adding fuzzy search, and sorting selected items to top. Also fix URL parsing and unknown message type errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename 'Projects' to 'Spaces' in Setup UI
Add fuzzy search bar to filter Spaces list
Sort Spaces list: Selected items always appear at the top
Fix 'Unknown message type: GET_BOARDS' error (remove or implement)
Fix 'Couldn't parse the host URL' error by ensuring domain is valid before use
Typecheck passes
notes.notes: Addressing user feedback and error logs.

notes.title: Fix Calendar UI Injection
notes.description: Fix the issue where the extension UI is not appearing in Google Calendar. Improve selector robustness and add debugging logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Update content script to use more robust selectors for finding the event modal
Add console logs to track injection attempts and failures
Ensure UI is injected into the correct container even if DOM structure varies
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
notes.notes: User reported UI not showing up.

notes.title: Fix CSP and Trusted Types Issues
notes.description: Resolve Content Security Policy and Trusted Types violations that prevent the extension from running in Google Calendar.
acceptanceCriteria: Eliminate 'eval' usage by switching to a manual build for the content script (IIFE format)
Remove dynamic imports from the content script loader to satisfy CSP
Ensure all DOM injections use Trusted Types policies
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
notes.notes: Critical fix for Google Calendar integration.

notes.title: Downgrade Zod to v3
notes.description: Downgrade Zod from v4 (alpha/beta) to v3 to avoid 'new Function' usage which violates CSP.
acceptanceCriteria: Update package.json to use zod ^3.24.1
Rebuild extension
Verify no 'new Function' or 'eval' errors in console
Typecheck passes
notes.notes: Zod v4 likely uses dynamic code generation for performance, which is blocked by Google Calendar's CSP.

notes.title: Downgrade React to v18
notes.description: Downgrade React from v19 to v18 to avoid Trusted Types violations in react-dom (innerHTML = '<script>').
acceptanceCriteria: Update package.json to use react ^18.3.1 and react-dom ^18.3.1
Rebuild extension
Verify no 'This document requires TrustedScript assignment' errors
Verify UI injection works
Typecheck passes
notes.notes: React 19 seems to have some feature detection code that violates strict Trusted Types policies.

notes.title: Switch to Preact
notes.description: Replace React with Preact to reduce bundle size and eliminate legacy feature detection code that violates Trusted Types.
acceptanceCriteria: Uninstall react and react-dom
Install preact
Configure Vite aliases for preact/compat
Rebuild extension
Verify content.js does not contain 'innerHTML = "<script>"'
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
notes.notes: Preact is lighter and cleaner for content scripts.

notes.title: Jira Task Status Management
notes.description: View and update the status of a linked Jira task directly from Google Calendar.
acceptanceCriteria: Display current status in Event Popup (Bubble) when title contains Jira key
Display current status in Edit Event Page when title contains Jira key
Allow changing status (transitioning the issue) from the UI
Sort task search results by status: In Progress > To Do > Done
Typecheck passes

notes.title: Smart Work Log Filtering
notes.description: Prevent duplicate worklogs by maintaining a lastLoggedTime pointer for each day.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain lastLoggedTime for each calendar date (LRU Cache ~30 days)
Only process events ending after lastLoggedTime
Ignore events currently in progress (Current Time < Event End Time)
Filter events ending between Start of Today and Current Time if syncing for Today
Typecheck passes

notes.title: Work Log Content Format
notes.description: Update worklog content format to include event details in the comment instead of task description.
acceptanceCriteria:
Format: [Event Title] 
[Date]
[Start Time] - [End Time]
[Event Description]
Add this content to Worklog Comment
Ensure main task description is not modified
Typecheck passes

notes.title: Setup Experience Improvements
notes.description: Improve Jira Domain input with flexible handling and auto-suggestions.
acceptanceCriteria: Allow flexible inputs (company, company.atlassian.net, full URL)
Auto-suggest 'company.atlassian.net' in dropdown
Update input value when suggestion is selected
Typecheck passes

notes.title: Fix Reload Focus Issue
notes.description: Ensure Jira autocomplete triggers correctly after page reload when clicking empty slot.
acceptanceCriteria: Correctly re-attach listeners to active input element after reload/navigation
Verify typing triggers autocomplete in the scenario
Typecheck passes

notes.title: Fix Linked Task Visibility
notes.description: Ensure currently linked task is always visible at the top of search results.
acceptanceCriteria: Always fetch and display linked issue (from title key) at top of results
Work even if search query is empty or unrelated
Typecheck passes
